channel.title: Bharat Naukri Alert — Latest Sarkari Updates
channel.description: Scholarships, exams, jobs aur sarkari schemes ke rozana updates with official links.

item.title: AIIMS Nagpur Medical Physicist Recruitment
item.description: AIIMS Nagpur is recruiting 2 Medical Physicist (Radiation Oncology) posts on a contract basis for 11 months. Applicants need an M.Sc. in Medical Physics or equivalent, or M.Sc. in Physics with a relevant diploma/degree, or M.Sc. in Medical Technology with Radiotherapy. Pay is Rs. 86,955 per month

item.title: NIA Ministerial Staff Recruitment 2026
item.description: National Investigation Agency (NIA) is inviting offline applications for 50 Ministerial Staff posts on a deputation basis, including LDC, UDC, Stenographer, Assistant, and others

item.title: CCRAS Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026
item.description: CCRAS invites applications for 20 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions for Ph.D. fellowships in Ayurveda and Yoga & Naturopathy for NET-qualified candidates with a postgraduate degree in Biomedical Sciences

item.title: WCCB Recruitment 2026 - Driver, Head Constable and More Posts

item.title: Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026
